correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md constructs resolvent numerators p_v(s)=c g_v ∏_{u not on P(v)}(s+k_u). Monic common-denominator multiplication gives a unit-lower-triangular transformation from the n outlet derivatives to descending numerator coefficients. Leaf deletion via division by (s+k_leaf) has unit determinant and remainder p_leaf(-k_leaf)=c g_leaf ∏_{i||leaf}(k_i-k_leaf), proving the formula inductively for all n and repeated k. Cayley–Hamilton shows kernel vectors have zero complete trace; a small kernel perturbation of a strictly positive baseline proves nonuniqueness among positive stores. Chain and star boundary cases checked; n=1 and shorter jets addressed. Reconstructed 874 parent-topological rooted trees with exact integer SymPy determinants, including n≤7; finite tests are corroboration only.
